comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Thanks. Tip: If you click Nanban Trade on the left side of this website and go to Market Rates for a region (Taiwan, Japan, etc.) you will find a table of all trade goods and the markets they can be sold in. Anything with a yellow/red sparkle indicates where they can be sold for the best profit (you can mouse over the sparkle for an area name like Iberia, if desired).

Cheers, and great online voyaging to you.
